accuracy.where: Intro line 11 ("keep them in files every later session reads"), callout line 31 ("the next session starts with your words"), The glossary line 116 ("`/setup-matt-pocock-skills`, just records where it lives"), Final test why-shared-words feedback line 452 ("so every session, reply and new file uses it")
accuracy.problem: The Lesson says every later session reads GLOSSARY.md, as if Claude Code loaded it automatically. It doesn't. Claude Code loads CLAUDE.md at the start of a session. GLOSSARY.md is read only by Skills whose instructions say to read it, or by sessions that a CLAUDE.md pointer sends there, and /setup-matt-pocock-skills writes that pointer. The Lesson calls this setup step trivial ("just records where it lives"), and the Try it never runs setup.
